verdict.rationale: Morph has a dedicated caching docs page stating that prefix caching is on automatically for every open-source model, with no configuration and no cache-write surcharge. That directly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: quantified latency or cost savings (cached-token discount rate, TTFT improvement), cache behavior details (TTL, minimum prefix length, scope), whether caching covers non-open-source or dedicated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
